name: Michael Ordenthal

nadir.desc: The property consists of a single large primary residence with a gray shingle roof and multiple solar panels|An attached garage with white doors is visible on one side of the house|A large in-ground swimming pool is located behind the main structure|The lot includes extensive green lawn, mature trees, and several detached structures with green roofs|A concrete driveway and parking area are present along one side of the house.

bravo.desc: The left side of the property shows the side and rear areas of the house, including the swimming pool and surrounding patio|A large detached structure with a green roof is visible, along with a blue SUV parked on the concrete area|Mature trees and landscaping are present along this side.

charlie.desc: The rear of the residence includes a large in-ground swimming pool with surrounding hardscape and lawn|Multiple solar panels are visible on the roof|Mature trees and shrubs border the rear yard, with a wooden fence visible along the back edge of the property.

delta.desc: The right side of the residence shows the side elevation of the house with mature trees in the foreground partially obscuring the view|The swimming pool is visible in the background|A wooden fence runs along the side of the property, and green lawn extends along this elevation.
